raw_ocr_text:
LAND AND PREMISES situate in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden and State of New Jersey as follows:
BEGINNING at a point at the Southwesterly corner of Concord Drive (50 feet wide) and Pennbrook Drive (50 feet wide); thence
1. South 33 degrees 20 minutes 00 seconds East, along Southwesterly line of Concord Drive, 60 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 46 and 47 on plan hereinafter mentioned; thence
2. South 56 degrees 40 minutes, 00 seconds West along said division line 125 feet to point corner to Lot 50 said plan; thence
3. North 33 degrees 20 minutes, 00 seconds West along said Lot 50, 60 feet to Southeasterly line of Pennbrook Drive; thence
4. North 56 degrees 40 minutes 00 seconds East along said Southeasterly line of Pennbrook Drive, 125 feet to the point and place of beginning.
THE ABOVE DESCRIBED tract or parcel of land and premises being described according to a Survey of Premises made by Walter H. Macnamara Assoc., Inc. Professional Land Surveyors, dated October 12, 2021.
